items.source: Post-process the given MutablePersistenceUnitInfo, for example registering further entity classes and jar files.
items.translation: 后处理给定的MutablePersistenceUnitInfo，例如注册更多的实体类和 jar 文件。

items.source: Implementations can be registered with a DefaultPersistenceUnitManager or via a LocalContainerEntityManagerFactoryBean.
items.translation: 实现可以通过DefaultPersistenceUnitManager注册，或者通过LocalContainerEntityManagerFactoryBean进行注册。

items.source: pui - the chosen persistence unit configuration, as read from persistence.xml. Passed in as MutablePersistenceUnitInfo.
items.translation: - 从 persistence.xml 读取的选定持久化单元配置。以 MutablePersistenceUnitInfo 形式传入。
